tooltip.exposure: Exposure in stops. +1 doubles linear RGB values.
tooltip.source_x: CIE x coordinate of the source white point.
tooltip.source_y: CIE y coordinate of the source white point.
tooltip.cr_balance: Exposure balance across the Cyan-Red axis. Positive values darken red and brighten cyan; negative values reverse the effect.
tooltip.yb_balance: Exposure balance across the Yellow-Blue axis. Positive values darken blue and brighten yellow; negative values reverse the effect.
tooltip.cr_spread: Change the Cyan-Red reference displacement from the working white point. -100 collapses the direction to white; +100 doubles it.
tooltip.yb_spread: Change the Yellow-Blue reference displacement from the working white point. -100 collapses the direction to white; +100 doubles it.
tooltip.cr_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Cyan-Red axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.yb_heading: Counterclockwise angle of the Yellow-Blue axis in the CIE xy plane.
tooltip.input_black: Inputs at this nit value map to black. Lower input values become pure black.
tooltip.input_shadows: Inputs at this nit value map to the neutral Shadows anchor.
tooltip.input_midtones: Inputs at this nit value map to the same perceptual lightness as 18% grey.
tooltip.input_white: Inputs at this nit value map to the neutral White anchor.
tooltip.input_highlights: Inputs at this nit value map to the neutral Peak anchor.
tooltip.fit: Higher values bring the curve closer to its control points and concentrate each point's influence.
tooltip.peak: Neutral luminance target for the highlight anchor.
tooltip.enabled: Include this Grade in the Stack.
